title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court and the Ministry of Justice on Printing and Distributing the Several Provisions on Fully Guaranteeing Lawyers' Lawful Performance of Defense Duties to Ensure the Quality of Death Penalty Case Handling
keywords_en: Performing defense duties to ensure proper handling of death penalty cases
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court, Ministry of Justice

Notice on Issuing the Several Provisions on Fully Guaranteeing Lawyers' Performance of Defense Duties According to Law and Ensuring the Quality of Death Penalty Case Handling

Fa Fa [2008] No. 14

The higher people's courts, departments (bureaus) of justice of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army, the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, and the Bureau of Justice of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps:

The Several Provisions on Fully Guaranteeing Lawyers' Performance of Defense Duties According to Law and Ensuring the Quality of Death Penalty Case Handling are hereby issued to you for your earnest compliance and implementation. Any circumstances during implementation and problems encountered shall be promptly reported to the Supreme People's Court and the Ministry of Justice respectively.

May 21, 2008

Supreme People's Court, Ministry of Justice

Several Provisions on Fully Guaranteeing Lawyers' Performance of Defense Duties According to Law and Ensuring the Quality of Death Penalty Case Handling

In order to ensure the quality of death penalty case handling, in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and relevant laws, regulations, and judicial interpretations, and in light of the actual circumstances of the people's courts' criminal adjudication work and lawyers' defense and legal aid work, the following provisions are hereby made on the specific issues concerning lawyers' performance of defense duties according to law in death penalty cases tried by the people's courts:

1.  The people's court shall, in accordance with the provisions of the Criminal Procedure Law, fully guarantee the right to defense and other lawful rights and interests of a defendant who may be sentenced to death, and shall fully guarantee the defense lawyer's performance of defense duties according to law. The judicial administrative organs and lawyers' associations shall strengthen guidance on the defense work in death penalty cases, actively strive for the government's financial departments to allocate and gradually increase the funding for legal aid work. Lawyers handling death penalty cases shall be dedicated to their duties and effectively protect the lawful rights and interests of the defendant.

2.  Where a defendant may be sentenced to death but has not entrusted a defender, the people's court shall, through the legal aid institution, designate a lawyer to provide defense for the defendant. If the defendant refuses the designated lawyer and has justifiable reasons, the people's court shall permit it, and the defendant may entrust another defender; if the defendant does not entrust a defender, the people's court shall notify the legal aid institution to designate another defender for the defendant; if the defendant refuses the newly designated lawyer again without justifiable reasons, the people's court shall not permit it and shall record the matter in the case file.

3.  The legal aid institution shall, within three days from the receipt of the notice of designation of defense, designate a lawyer with experience in court defense in criminal cases to serve as the defender in the death penalty case.

4.  A lawyer designated to serve as the defender in a death penalty case shall not transfer the case to a lawyer assistant for handling; if there are justifiable reasons for not being able to accept the designation, with the consent of the legal aid institution, the legal aid institution shall designate another lawyer to handle the case.

5.  After accepting a death penalty case, the people's court shall promptly notify the defense lawyer to review the case files, and shall actively create conditions to facilitate the lawyer's review and copying of materials concerning the alleged criminal facts.

For lawyers handling legal aid cases, the people's court shall waive or reduce the copying fees for copying evidentiary materials that involve the main criminal facts of the defendant and directly affect the determination of guilt and sentencing, charging only the necessary production cost for copying.

After a lawyer accepts the entrustment or is designated as the defender in a death penalty case, the lawyer shall promptly go to the people's court to review the case files; with respect to materials reviewed that involve state secrets, trade secrets, personal privacy, or witness identity, the lawyer shall maintain confidentiality.

6.  The lawyer shall meet with the defendant in custody before the court session, inquire whether the defendant agrees to the lawyer's defense, and listen to the defendant's statements and opinions.

7.  Where a lawyer makes a written application to the people's court to collect or obtain evidence, apply for a witness to testify in court, or apply for an expert evaluation, supplementary evaluation, or re-evaluation, the people's court shall promptly give a written reply and attach it to the case file.

8.  Before the opening of the second instance court session, if the people's procuratorate submits new evidence or conducts a re-evaluation or supplementary evaluation, the people's court shall, at the latest three days before the court session, notify the lawyer to review it.

9.  A lawyer appearing in court for defense shall make thorough preparations, and based on the facts, evidence, applicable law, sentencing, and litigation procedures of the case, shall present defense opinions concerning the defendant's innocence, lesser guilt, or mitigation or exemption of criminal liability, thereby genuinely ensuring the quality of the defense and protecting the defendant's lawful rights and interests.

10. Upon receiving the notice of court session from the people's court, the lawyer shall ensure attendance at the court session on time. The people's court shall hold the court session on time. If the court cannot hold the session on schedule due to reasons, or if the lawyer has justifiable reasons for being unable to appear on schedule, the people's court shall reschedule the court session at a different time without affecting the case handling time limit, and shall notify the parties, the lawyer, and the people's procuratorate three days before the court session.

11. The people's court shall strengthen the security of the trial premises, protect the personal safety of lawyers and other litigation participants, and ensure the smooth conduct of the trial activities.

12. The judge shall conduct trial activities strictly in accordance with the statutory litigation procedures, respect the lawyer's litigation rights, carefully listen to the opinions of both the prosecution and the defense, and ensure the completeness of the lawyer's presentation. Where a lawyer's presentation is overly lengthy, obviously repetitive, or irrelevant to the case, or where the presentation during a public trial involves state secrets or personal privacy, or constitutes a personal attack, the judge shall remind or stop the lawyer.

13. During the court trial, the people's court shall truthfully and in detail record the lawyer's opinions. After the court trial concludes, the lawyer shall submit a written defense opinion to the people's court within three days after the session.

14. When the people's court tries a criminal case where the defendant may be sentenced to death and a civil action for compensation is appended, and when mediating on the compensation matters, the lawyer shall, within the scope of their duties and authority, in accordance with the law and based on the specific circumstances of the case and the parties, present opinions that are conducive to the handling of the case and effectively protect the lawful rights and interests of the parties, thereby promoting the mediated settlement of the appended civil action case.

15. In the judgment document, the people's court shall specify the legal aid institution that designated the lawyer as the defender, the lawyer's name, and the law firm where the lawyer practices. The collegial panel and the judicial committee shall carefully study the lawyer's defense opinions when discussing the case, and shall state in the judgment document the reasons for adopting or not adopting them.

The people's court shall serve the judgment document on the lawyer in accordance with the relevant provisions.

16. During the trial of a case by the people's court, if a lawyer requests a meeting with the judge, the collegial panel may, based on the specific circumstances of the case, arrange for a meeting during working hours and at the working premises to hear the lawyer's opinions. During the meeting, the court clerk shall make a record, which shall be signed by the lawyer and attached to the case file.

17. During the review period of a death penalty case, if the defendant's lawyer requests to present opinions in person or submit evidentiary materials, the relevant collegial panel of the people's court shall receive the lawyer during working hours and at the working premises, and shall make a record to be attached to the case file. The written opinions submitted by the lawyer shall be attached to the case file.

18. The judicial administrative organs and lawyers' associations shall strengthen professional guidance and training for lawyers, as well as education on professional ethics and practice discipline, continuously improve the quality of lawyers handling death penalty cases, and establish an assessment mechanism for lawyers engaged in legal aid work.
